summary: All factual claims, numbers and context statements in the summary are fully supported by the provided reporting.

claims.claim: Construction is set to begin on Australia's largest wind farm to be built in two years.
claims.evidence: Construction will soon begin on the nation's largest wind farm to be built in two years, but frustrated residents say they are bearing the brunt of Australia's push for net zero.

claims.claim: Danish investors Copenhagen Infrastructure Partners acquired the Gawara Baya wind farm project from WindLab and announced that construction of 68 turbines and a 100-megawatt battery near Mount Fox in north Queensland will begin imminently.
claims.evidence: The Gawara Baya wind farm includes 68 turbines and a 100-megawatt battery spread over 148 hectares near the 100,000-year-old dormant volcano Mount Fox in north Queensland. Danish investors Copenhagen Infrastructure Partners (CIP) acquired the project from WindLab earlier this month, announcing funding was ready and construction would begin 'imminently'.

claims.claim: The project is the first wind farm to reach construction under the federal government's Capacity Investment Scheme, which guarantees electricity prices to reduce investor risk.
claims.evidence: This project is the first wind farm to reach construction under the federal government's Capacity Investment Scheme and represents a breaking of a deadlock, according to Grattan Institute climate and energy program director Alison Reeve.

claims.claim: Local resident group Keep Mount Fox Wild opposes the development over environmental and biodiversity concerns, while project developers and local council representatives cite economic benefits and employment creation of about 500 construction jobs.
claims.evidence: Ms Armstrong founded community group Keep Mount Fox Wild, which she said included about half of the town's residents. 'There are several wind farms earmarked for up here. We just don't want them,' she said.

claims.claim: There are 68 wind turbines in the Gawara Baya wind farm.
claims.evidence: The Gawara Baya wind farm includes 68 turbines and a 100-megawatt battery spread over 148 hectares near the 100,000-year-old dormant volcano Mount Fox in north Queensland.

claims.claim: The battery included in the wind farm project has a capacity of 100 megawatts.
claims.evidence: The Gawara Baya wind farm includes 68 turbines and a 100-megawatt battery spread over 148 hectares near the 100,000-year-old dormant volcano Mount Fox in north Queensland.

claims.claim: The wind farm covers an area of 148 hectares near Mount Fox.
claims.evidence: The Gawara Baya wind farm includes 68 turbines and a 100-megawatt battery spread over 148 hectares near the 100,000-year-old dormant volcano Mount Fox in north Queensland.

claims.claim: Mount Fox has an approximate population of 84 residents.
claims.evidence: Mount Fox near Ingham has about 84 residents and neighbours the world heritage listed Wet Tropics.

claims.claim: The project advances the federal government's 2030 target of 82 per cent renewables while generating local employment and drawing opposition from regional residents.
claims.evidence: Under the scheme, which aims to help achieve the target of 82 per cent renewables by 2030, the government guarantees the price for electricity, subsidising the producer if electricity prices fall and sharing in profits if prices rise above a certain price.
